bullets: Added a new /byok effort command letting BYOK users choose low, medium, or high reasoning effort per run, saved in settings and translated per provider dialect.
Fixed file edits cut off mid-generation so the assistant refuses to save truncated writes instead of leaving broken files behind.
Capped reasoning effort at high for GPT-6.1 Sol, Muse Spark, and Gemini 3.8 Flash after measuring the cost and latency of the maximum level.
Improved quota display so the CLI counter and reset countdown resolve the same shared usage pool instead of mismatched limits.
Stopped daily-limit refusals from falling back to another model, ending the run and telling users when the chosen model is available again.
Moved Freebuff auth tokens to the OS keychain so login secrets are stored via OS keychain or credentials manager rather than plain files.
Added server model catalog support so the picker list loads from the internet instead of a compiled directory, overriding model pricing and limits.
Improved BYOK diagnostics so missing or invalid credentials name the exact environment variable and report the HTTP status.
Fixed chat input Up/Down paging so recalled history entries keep navigating backward through past prompts without resetting.
Added endpoint status reporting to BYOK validation, warning when a selected model is absent from the provider's published model list.
